summary.text: Freezing Rain Frozen Earth is a battlefield killer move in Yu Lu blessed land. Every hour there is intense freezing rain, as well as attacks from snow monsters.

claims.text: Sha Nan Jiang leads Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng through Yu Lu blessed land’s entrance into a frozen world that is completely white, and names this third round after vanishing immortal essence dissipation rain. Fang Yuan uses several wisdom path investigative killer moves in front of Shark Demon’s group and finds no flaws. The battlefield is completely unchanged and intact.

He judges it fused with Yu Lu blessed land and created using the dao marks in the blessed land, more advanced than Lang Ya land spirit’s refusal to set a battlefield killer move inside Lang Ya blessed land. Most Gu Immortals dare not use a battlefield killer move in their immortal apertures, because temporary dao marks can clash with the small world’s dao marks. Fairy Yu Lu, a disciple of Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable, counters that weakness. Fang Yuan wants her inheritance, even a single battlefield killer move that suits him.

The battlefield is made using the dao marks inside Yu Lu blessed land, not temporary dao marks. Destroying it would damage those dao marks and the blessed land. Shark Demon’s group came for inheritance and resources, so they try to unravel it rather than break it by force. Fang Yuan’s first deductions hit a giant barrier. He does not know where to start, and treats the move as worthy of the rank eight great expert Fairy Yu Lu.

When the hour comes, a drizzle of freezing rain falls as tiny ice needles, then ice darts, then an icicle storm. A sixty feet tall desolate beast level snow monster charges out of the rain. Snow monsters that die in battle revive. They vanish when the time is up and reappear with the next freezing rain. A companion compares the move to Reincarnation Battlefield and guesses Fairy Yu Lu gained insight on reincarnation and rebirth from Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable.

The attack opens tiny flaws. Fang Yuan finds a mortal Gu coordinated with countless mortal Gu and Immortal Gu. Destroying it weakens the freezing rain, then the storm becomes three times as fierce, and two more flaws appear.

On a later assault the battlefield has completely recovered. With prior experience Fang Yuan does not destroy the crucial mortal Gu, so the battlefield does not grow stronger. Shark Demon uses melt ice Immortal Gu, an ice path Immortal Gu borrowed from a Zombie Alliance member to melt even the firmest ice. It greatly resists the move’s power, obstructs desolate beast level snow monsters, and cuts immortal essence expenditure. After thirty-three attacks, with Bo Dan’s support, the battlefield is unraveled.
Fighting soul battlefield has no such traps. Destroying a hidden spot there causes no backlash, and Fang Yuan does not need to restart his deductions.

After eight doors labyrinth falls, Fang Yuan counts three battlefield killer moves he met in Yu Lu blessed land: freezing rain frozen earth, fighting soul battlefield, and eight doors labyrinth. They come from different paths, yet they do not clash with the blessed land and seem to complement each other.

When Shark Demon’s group is stuck in the snow and ice again, Fang Yuan as Chen Dao names the battlefield and the layers under it: fighting soul battlefield, eight doors labyrinth, and unmoving troops. He weakens it step by step without increasing its power, until sixty percent is gone.

After resting a few days he re-enters, uses star thought Immortal Gu over many days, and finishes unraveling it. After that refinement he grasps eighty to ninety percent of freezing rain frozen earth, fighting soul battlefield, and eight doors labyrinth, even without the Immortal Gu needed to recreate them.
